title: Datos BTC/USDT spot — cobertura y calidad

panels.title: Velas almacenadas
panels.description: Consulta el histórico cargado, independiente del selector temporal. Solo Binance spot BTC/USDT 1m. La cobertura comprueba meses con datos; no certifica calidad de precios.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS velas FROM ohlcv WHERE symbol = 'BTC/USDT' AND exchange = 'binance_spot' AND timeframe = '1m'

panels.title: Última vela UTC
panels.description: Consulta el histórico cargado, independiente del selector temporal. Solo Binance spot BTC/USDT 1m. La cobertura comprueba meses con datos; no certifica calidad de precios.

targets.rawSql: SELECT max(time) AS ultima_vela FROM ohlcv WHERE symbol = 'BTC/USDT' AND exchange = 'binance_spot' AND timeframe = '1m'

panels.title: Primera vela UTC
panels.description: Consulta el histórico cargado, independiente del selector temporal. Solo Binance spot BTC/USDT 1m. La cobertura comprueba meses con datos; no certifica calidad de precios.

targets.rawSql: SELECT min(time) AS primera_vela FROM ohlcv WHERE symbol = 'BTC/USDT' AND exchange = 'binance_spot' AND timeframe = '1m'

panels.title: Cobertura por mes completo (UTC)
panels.description: Consulta el histórico cargado, independiente del selector temporal. Solo Binance spot BTC/USDT 1m. La cobertura comprueba meses con datos; no certifica calidad de precios.

targets.rawSql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT date_trunc('month', time AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS mes, count(*) AS velas FROM ohlcv WHERE symbol = 'BTC/USDT' AND exchange = 'binance_spot' AND timeframe = '1m' GROUP BY 1) SELECT mes, velas, (extract(epoch FROM (mes + interval '1 month' - mes))/60)::bigint AS esperadas, (extract(epoch FROM (mes + interval '1 month' - mes))/60)::bigint - velas AS minutos_ausentes, round(100.0*velas/(extract(epoch FROM (mes + interval '1 month' - mes))/60), 2) AS cobertura_pct FROM monthly ORDER BY mes DESC

panels.title: Cierre por hora — últimos 30 días cargados
panels.description: Consulta el histórico cargado, independiente del selector temporal. Solo Binance spot BTC/USDT 1m. La cobertura comprueba meses con datos; no certifica calidad de precios.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('1 hour', time) AS time, last(close,time) AS cierre FROM ohlcv WHERE symbol = 'BTC/USDT' AND exchange = 'binance_spot' AND timeframe = '1m' AND time >= (SELECT max(time) - interval '30 days' FROM ohlcv WHERE symbol = 'BTC/USDT' AND exchange = 'binance_spot' AND timeframe = '1m') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Últimas 20 velas (UTC)
panels.description: Consulta el histórico cargado, independiente del selector temporal. Solo Binance spot BTC/USDT 1m. La cobertura comprueba meses con datos; no certifica calidad de precios.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time, open, high, low, close, volume FROM ohlcv WHERE symbol = 'BTC/USDT' AND exchange = 'binance_spot' AND timeframe = '1m' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 20
